messages.content: Each word in your response must start with the next letter of the alphabet, looping back to 'A' after 'Z'. Nest parentheses (and [brackets {and braces}]) at least 5 levels deep. for a sci fi story, how would the protagonist losing three of his friends and even his love interest permanently to an cybernetic virus, only for the protagonist to save a clone of his love interest from the same lab that created the virus, and starts the journey of getting to know her all over again, and falling in love again, be subverting tropes, and what tropes would those be?
